title: Uri Geller abducted as a child
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Uri Geller abducted as a child, about Geller's childhood at Israel, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Yuri Geller has a similar story of being abducted, I think, as a as a young child and then he gained his psychic powers that way.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Uri Geller, a man famous for claiming psychic powers, has a story of being abducted as a young child. According to Michels, Geller says he gained his psychic abilities that way. If true, it would link alien encounters to unusual powers of the mind.
